operations.coverage: Union eligible nominal feature windows; separately union known actual support.
operations.summary: Median of accepted method-compatible feature values unless a statistic is explicitly requested.
operations.episode: Configured threshold, minimum grouping span and maximum gap; qualifying coverage and grouping span remain distinct.
operations.comparison: Median eligible target value minus the named immutable reference center.
operations.anchors: Only source-valid, semantically supported events with the requested action/assertion/evidence state.
